comment: This class was extremely easy. Did not have to do any of the readings. The lectures were very boring and hard to follow. Offered numerous extra credit opportunities. Grades everything extremely generously. You have to put in maybe 10 hours of outside work total for this class the entire semester.

Lectures are soooooo boring but this is the easiest class I've taken at Richmond by far. His grading is very generous and his expectations for the class are very clear. If you're looking for an easy class to fill a gened or premed requirement definitely take SOC 101 with Yetkin.
Great guy, cares about his students. Can be boring but overall good teacher.
Very very boring, but SO EASY!! As long as you do the readings and talk, you will do fine. Overall grade was greater than 100.

Very obtainable to get an A if you show up to class and talk. If you do the readings, you will be fine. Quizzes are longer essays answering questions and it is easy to get an A on those if you put in the time to work on them thoroughly. Final and mid-term are harder. The midterm was curved but final was not. Overall, participation matters most.

Easy class if you do the reading outside of class. Offers bonus points for answering questions in class, but he graded the bonus points incorrectly, so they actually lowered my grade in the class instead of bringing it up. Several group projects, but they're pretty simple. The exams are pretty simple, mixture of multiple choice and essays.
He literally is the most boring teacher I've ever had. He also is not very helpful if you need help outside of class. But, his expectations are clear and tests are easy to study for.

Definitely recommend this class to any student looking to get an easy A. This class is made up of 2 big exams (midterm and final) and 2 group projects. Participation is not incorporated to the final class, so all you need to do is show up to class and take notes on his powerpoints!
